messages:
Leah: Heads-up: planning weighted header-based shift for router/router-frontend at 01:30 UTC. Target: green-v3. Steps: 15% -> 35% -> 65% -> 100%, 4m waits. Health gates: error-rate <0.7%, p99 < 800ms globally.
Sam: Copy. Change window is within maintenance 01:00-02:00, ok to proceed.
Diego: Are we toggling header "X-Use-Model: v3"? Any client-side adapter change?
Leah: Yes header toggle. No client changes expected; SDK will fall back. We'll publish note re: header.
DeployBot: routeshift:init id=rs-20240515-41 payload={"from":"green-v2","to":"green-v3","mode":"header-weighted","header":"X-Use-Model","steps":[15,35,65,100],"wait":"4m"} initiated by Leah at 1735554321
Amanda: I pushed release-notes draft to the release doc. Adding rollback instructions and observability links.
DeployBot: step 1 complete \u2014 15% header weighted. metrics: errors=0.45%, p99=420ms.
Diego: Observing a small error uptick in apac-sg cluster (0.9%). Tagging /ops to check edge.
Ops-Bot: Alert: apac-sg edge-7 error-rate >0.8% for 2m.
Sam: Pause on global progression. Leah, can we apply regional fallback for apac?
Leah: Apply header-exclude apac rule (send apac traffic to old header). @DeployBot region-override id=rs-20240515-41 region=apac override={"mode":"passthrough","to":"green-v2"}
DeployBot: region-override applied: apac pinned to green-v2. Global progress paused at 15%.
Diego: Quick check logs from edge-7:
```
2024-05-15T01:33:12Z ERROR upstream:429 timeout
trace_id=abc123 model-pool=pool-apac-9
```
Diego: Looks like pool-apac-9 had transient OOMs after v3 startup. I'll drain and roll-forward an instance on a larger flavor. ETA ~6m.
DeployBot: scale:pool pool-apac-9 target_size=4->5 requested by Diego.
DeployBot: scale:pool completed. New instance booting.
Sam: Adding note: disable auto-promote on header changes until post-ops okay.
Amanda: Updating release notes: header toggle, apac hotfix, regional pin.
Leah: Once pool stabilizes and apac errors <0.5% for 10m we resume. Target resume 01:50 UTC.
DeployBot: admin:resume requires manual approval.
Diego: New instance shows healthy, no OOMs in logs. edge-7 error-rate back to 0.3%.
Ops-Bot: apac-sg error alert cleared.
Leah: Ok resume global shift at next step. @DeployBot resume id=rs-20240515-41 by Leah
DeployBot: resumed. progressing to 35%...
DeployBot: step 2 complete \u2014 35% header weighted. metrics: errors=0.28%, p99=410ms.
Sam: Nice. Proceeding to 65% after 4m.
DeployBot: step 3 complete \u2014 65% header weighted. metrics stable.
Amanda: Finalizing release notes and publishing changelog. Owners: Leah/Diego/Sam.
Leah: Final 100% in 4m. If anything spikes, rollback by removing header toggles.
DeployBot: step 4 complete \u2014 100% traffic via header v3. All region overrides cleared. metrics: errors=0.22%, p99=395ms.
Leah: Live. Marking release as done. Adding postmortem checklist for apac pool sizing. Thanks all. :tada:
